facts.business: Athena Global Technologies Limited is an Indian listed company with investments in subsidiaries operating in medical solutions, ed-tech, and US-based operations.
facts.related_party_note: During the year ended 31 March 2026, the Company disposed of its entire investment in Medley Medical Solutions Private Limited to MedleyMed Healthcare Solutions Private Limited for a consideration of Rs 125.24 lakh. The carrying amount of the investment on the date of disposal was Rs 3,360.94 lakh, resulting in a loss of Rs 3,235.60 lakh. The acquisition of 100% equity share capital of MedleyMed Healthcare Solutions Private Limited for Rs 0.10 lakh also constituted a related-party transaction.
